node.statement: Application 2 (Shadow tomography): Given n copies of rho, predict E[tr(O_i rho)] for m observables O_1,...,O_m with ||O_i|| <= 1 and tr(O_i^2) <= F, to accuracy epsilon. Using Mix+(GPS), the sample complexity is n = O(log(m)(min{sqrt(rF)/eps, F^{2/3}/eps^{4/3}} + 1/eps^2)), matching the best known bounds and extending them optimally to the mixed-state setting. Proof: The unbiased estimator and SoS second moment structure enable the online shadow tomography framework of [PSW25].
